rag.text:
Test: TC-2578 — Box Module - Overview - Moving an unarchived Box under an archived Box
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-59 Box Module - Overview
Labels: teamboxes

Steps:
1. Navigate to Overview module of Root Box.
   Expected: Overview module loads and boxes are displayed.
2. Open a View dropdown and enable the Archived Boxes option.
   Expected: The checkbox next to the Archived Boxes option is checked and Archived Boxes appear in the Box hierarchy.
3. Open Search, put "TC-2578" in the Search field and press Enter.
   Expected: The folLowing Boxes are displayed:
- TC-2578 unarchived
- TC-2578 archived
4. Move boxName under a boxName2 via drag&drop
   Data: boxName: TC-2578 unarchived
boxName2: TC-2578 archived
   Expected: Parent change confirmation modal appears.
5. Press Confirm button.
   Expected: "Failed to move items

Chosen items cannot be moved as sub-items to archived TC-2578 archived. If you want to move them to archived TC-2578 archived, archive these items first." warning appears.
